title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 20 in A minor

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6), with the alto's line in the soprano, the bass's line in the alto, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From A minor to C major

sections.label: Answer in C major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From C major to E minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1.
sections.leads: From E minor to A minor

sections.label: Answer in A minor, rhythm varied (Alto)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (5 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6), with the alto's line in the soprano, a third lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times).
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Answer in A minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in A minor at bar 28

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 1 (bars 8–9). Returns in Episode 5 (bars 23–25).

sequences.text: a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar
a sequence falling by a step every half bar
